info.description: Image or video in a media grid, with an optional lightbox title and caption

media.description: Image or video for this tile.

poster.description: Thumbnail for a video tile. If empty, the video’s first frame is used.

title.description: Optional. Shown under the tile when titles are enabled, and along the bottom of the lightbox.

caption.description: Optional. Shown with the title along the bottom of the lightbox.

categories.description: Add one entry per tag. Use the same label as a category on this Media Grid.
